sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD admission with a bachelor's is permitted; about two-thirds of admits have bachelor's degrees. GPA
below 3.0 is not considered (page also says above 3.0). Require two terms each of advanced analysis and
advanced algebra; for quarter institutions three terms are encouraged. Courses may be in progress.
International applicants are eligible. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD in USC's Liaison application. Mathematics and Applied Mathematics are reviewed
together; applying to both has no advantage. Arrange official-issued transcripts and three academic referees
early. Request any fee waiver before submission. Establish English exemption or submit official scores. [s1] [s2]
[s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Faculty contact is not listed as a required pre-admission step. Use the verified profiles to discuss fit and
availability. Confirm Kyler Siegel's USC supervision plans because his own page says Imperial appointment and
USC leave. [s1] [s11] [s12] [s21]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
USC Liaison public help covers Program Materials, recommendation workflow and submission. Once submitted,
existing material is largely locked; permitted additions do not override the Math December 15 deadline.
Transcripts may require up to 15 business days processing in the busy season. [s2] [s6] [s7]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Fall 2027 central fee and Spring 2027-onward English policy verified. Math's December 15 deadline is
standing/undated. Funding dollar floor is AY 2026-27; Fall 2027 amount unresolved. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s8]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
Math lists TOEFL 100, IELTS 7 or PTE 68. Central policy for Spring 2027 onward accepts TOEFL, IELTS, PTE and
Cambridge C1 Advanced; scores valid two years at submission. Its PhD ISE-exemption thresholds are old TOEFL
100/20 each, new TOEFL 5/4 each, IELTS 7/6 each, PTE 68/53 each, Cambridge 185/169 each; distinguish
placement thresholds from departmental admission rules. Official scores required; ETS 4852. Confirm the Math
policy for the new TOEFL scale/Cambridge. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Central graduate policy exempts a holder of a US bachelor's degree, including permitted transferred credits.
Completed UChicago degree fits. A still-pending bachelor's is not explicitly covered by 'hold': obtain
confirmation. A bachelor's exemption does not itself exempt the separate ITA interview. ITA test may be
waived for TOEFL speaking/listening 6/5.5 (old 29/25) or IELTS 8.5/7, but the department may still require it.
[s3] [s10]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not considered. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional and considered; especially encouraged for applicants from less familiar institutions or nontraditional
preparation. [s1]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Records from every postsecondary institution. USC requires official-issued records; a student-portal printout is
unacceptable. Central transcript instructions allow a scan of an official-issued record, mail or secure electronic
delivery. The application guide also describes official records sent directly; safest is official-issued upload plus
direct delivery. Electronic transcripts go to etrans@usc.edu after submission and receipt of the ten-digit USC
ID. Include original-language records and word-for-word English translations where applicable; no WES
substitute. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate Math course-list requirement identified in the departmental list. Advanced algebra and analysis
prerequisites must be visible in records; inspect the live program questions. [s1]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]

analysis/algebra is unclear. [s1]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required. Ideally all are higher-education mathematics faculty who taught the applicant for at least a
semester within the last three years; at least one should have supervised mathematical research. The page
excludes unsuitable sources such as high-school teachers, TAs, coaches and coworkers; nontraditional paths
should meet the spirit of these criteria. [s1]

Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No additional initial reference stated for the automatically considered Math funding package. External
fellowship requirements are award-specific. [s1] [s9]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Saving a recommendation request sends the invitation immediately; use an accurate email and contact details.
Sender is support@usc.myliaison.com. Referee completes the program's assessment/questions and uploads a
letter. [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations can be sent before submission; not dependent on submitting the paid application. [s6]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Liaison shows completion status/date and sends a recommendation-received notification. Transcript processing
is separate and may take substantially longer. [s6] [s2]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
A completed recommendation cannot be removed or replaced in the application. Unsubmitted requests can be
edited; permitted new requests may be added after submission, subject to Math's hard deadline. Details can
be reused, but reuse of the actual letter across programs/cycles was not established. [s6]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
The university's AY 2026-27 minimum total doctoral stipend is $42,436, plus tuition remission and specified
health support. This is a prior-year university floor, not a published Fall 2027 Math offer; the memo does not
justify converting it into a particular monthly or summer schedule. Math promises tuition, health and dental
benefits with its package. [s8] [s1]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All admitted doctoral students receive a five-year support package: typically one fellowship year and four TA
years. [s1]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
The departmental package applies to admitted students regardless of nationality. International teaching
assignments require separate English clearance. [s1] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Teaching years carry TA duties and university academic/assistantship conditions; detailed annual workload and
renewal milestones were not established from the admissions page. An ITA Pending Test restriction can block
tuition assistance until proficiency or required language-course enrollment is established. [s1] [s10]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Standard departmental support is awarded with admission; no separate support application specified.
University fellowships generally require departmental nomination. [s1] [s9]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
University fellowships and external fellowship coordination are available, subject to award-specific eligibility.
No Math-specific additional guaranteed dollar amount established. [s9]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
$120 for most graduate programs in the Fall 2027 application guide; the older Fall 2026 fee was $105. Pay
electronically using accepted cards. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Start the application but do not submit/pay before USC approves a waiver; allow three to four business days.
International financial-hardship requests are not generally eligible. Math advertises a specific waiver for NAM
Undergraduate MathFest 2026 attendees: contact Alexis Teodoro (ateodoro@usc.edu) with attendance
confirmation, obtain the department letter, then follow central waiver instructions. Other central qualifying
programs may apply. [s1] [s5]

Pay attention to
• Hard December 15 materials cutoff; no published grace period.
• General GRE is not considered; Math GRE is optional.
• Admission English exemption and ITA clearance are separate.
• USC minimum stipend found is 2026-27, not a Fall 2027 offer.
• Montgomery recent-paper check remains unresolved.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD admission with a bachelor's is permitted; about two-thirds of admits have bachelor's degrees. GPA
below 3.0 is not considered (page also says above 3.0). Require two terms each of advanced analysis and
advanced algebra; for quarter institutions three terms are encouraged. Courses may be in progress.
International applicants are eligible. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD in USC's Liaison application. Mathematics and Applied Mathematics are reviewed
together; applying to both has no advantage. Arrange official-issued transcripts and three academic referees
early. Request any fee waiver before submission. Establish English exemption or submit official scores. [s1] [s2]
[s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Faculty contact is not listed as a required pre-admission step. Use the verified profiles to discuss fit and
availability. Confirm Kyler Siegel's USC supervision plans because his own page says Imperial appointment and
USC leave. [s1] [s11] [s12] [s21]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
USC Liaison public help covers Program Materials, recommendation workflow and submission. Once submitted,
existing material is largely locked; permitted additions do not override the Math December 15 deadline.
Transcripts may require up to 15 business days processing in the busy season. [s2] [s6] [s7]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Fall 2027 central fee and Spring 2027-onward English policy verified. Math's December 15 deadline is
standing/undated. Funding dollar floor is AY 2026-27; Fall 2027 amount unresolved. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s8]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Funding consideration; Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting
documents [Standing rule]
Department states December 15, a hard deadline for all application materials, with no materials accepted
afterward. Public departmental page does not label Fall 2027. Liaison submission/payment cutoff is 11:59 p.m.
Pacific. No separate Math funding or referee grace deadline established; complete by the department deadline.

English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
Math lists TOEFL 100, IELTS 7 or PTE 68. Central policy for Spring 2027 onward accepts TOEFL, IELTS, PTE and
Cambridge C1 Advanced; scores valid two years at submission. Its PhD ISE-exemption thresholds are old TOEFL
100/20 each, new TOEFL 5/4 each, IELTS 7/6 each, PTE 68/53 each, Cambridge 185/169 each; distinguish
placement thresholds from departmental admission rules. Official scores required; ETS 4852. Confirm the Math
policy for the new TOEFL scale/Cambridge. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Central graduate policy exempts a holder of a US bachelor's degree, including permitted transferred credits.
Completed UChicago degree fits. A still-pending bachelor's is not explicitly covered by 'hold': obtain
confirmation. A bachelor's exemption does not itself exempt the separate ITA interview. ITA test may be
waived for TOEFL speaking/listening 6/5.5 (old 29/25) or IELTS 8.5/7, but the department may still require it.
[s3] [s10]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not considered. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional and considered; especially encouraged for applicants from less familiar institutions or nontraditional
preparation. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Records from every postsecondary institution. USC requires official-issued records; a student-portal printout is
unacceptable. Central transcript instructions allow a scan of an official-issued record, mail or secure electronic
delivery. The application guide also describes official records sent directly; safest is official-issued upload plus
direct delivery. Electronic transcripts go to etrans@usc.edu after submission and receipt of the ten-digit USC
ID. Include original-language records and word-for-word English translations where applicable; no WES
substitute. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate Math course-list requirement identified in the departmental list. Advanced algebra and analysis
prerequisites must be visible in records; inspect the live program questions. [s1]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No mandatory course-description upload established. Prepare descriptions if equivalence of advanced
analysis/algebra is unclear. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required. Ideally all are higher-education mathematics faculty who taught the applicant for at least a
semester within the last three years; at least one should have supervised mathematical research. The page
excludes unsuitable sources such as high-school teachers, TAs, coaches and coworkers; nontraditional paths
should meet the spirit of these criteria. [s1]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Saving a recommendation request sends the invitation immediately; use an accurate email and contact details.
Sender is support@usc.myliaison.com. Referee completes the program's assessment/questions and uploads a
letter. [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations can be sent before submission; not dependent on submitting the paid application. [s6]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Liaison shows completion status/date and sends a recommendation-received notification. Transcript processing
is separate and may take substantially longer. [s6] [s2]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
A completed recommendation cannot be removed or replaced in the application. Unsubmitted requests can be
edited; permitted new requests may be added after submission, subject to Math's hard deadline. Details can
be reused, but reuse of the actual letter across programs/cycles was not established. [s6]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Short CV required. Public Math admissions page gives no exact page count, file format or filename rule. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Statement of purpose required. Exact Math PhD prompt, length and formatting are not published on the
accessible departmental page; inspect Program Materials. Do not import the 750-word Mathematical Finance
master's requirement. [s1] [s6]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary;
Publications list; Course-list document; Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No distinct requirement or exact prompt established in the public Math PhD checklist; inspect the live
program-specific fields. Absence from the list is not confirmation that an optional slot exists. [s1] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Research interests may be explained in the statement of purpose; no separate required research-interest
statement or exact prompt established. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
No separate initial essay stated for the standard Math doctoral package. Any outside award has its own
application. [s1] [s9]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
The university's AY 2026-27 minimum total doctoral stipend is $42,436, plus tuition remission and specified
health support. This is a prior-year university floor, not a published Fall 2027 Math offer; the memo does not
justify converting it into a particular monthly or summer schedule. Math promises tuition, health and dental
benefits with its package. [s8] [s1]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All admitted doctoral students receive a five-year support package: typically one fellowship year and four TA
years. [s1]

The departmental package applies to admitted students regardless of nationality. International teaching
assignments require separate English clearance. [s1] [s10]

Teaching years carry TA duties and university academic/assistantship conditions; detailed annual workload and

Standard departmental support is awarded with admission; no separate support application specified.

University fellowships and external fellowship coordination are available, subject to award-specific eligibility.
No Math-specific additional guaranteed dollar amount established. [s9]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
$120 for most graduate programs in the Fall 2027 application guide; the older Fall 2026 fee was $105. Pay
electronically using accepted cards. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Start the application but do not submit/pay before USC approves a waiver; allow three to four business days.
International financial-hardship requests are not generally eligible. Math advertises a specific waiver for NAM
Undergraduate MathFest 2026 attendees: contact Alexis Teodoro (ateodoro@usc.edu) with attendance
confirmation, obtain the department letter, then follow central waiver instructions. Other central qualifying
programs may apply. [s1] [s5]

Pay attention to
• Hard December 15 materials cutoff; no published grace period.

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD admission with a bachelor's is permitted; about two-thirds of admits have bachelor's degrees. GPA
below 3.0 is not considered (page also says above 3.0). Require two terms each of advanced analysis and
advanced algebra; for quarter institutions three terms are encouraged. Courses may be in progress.
International applicants are eligible. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose Mathematics PhD in USC's Liaison application. Mathematics and Applied Mathematics are reviewed
together; applying to both has no advantage. Arrange official-issued transcripts and three academic referees
early. Request any fee waiver before submission. Establish English exemption or submit official scores. [s1] [s2]
[s5]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Faculty contact is not listed as a required pre-admission step. Use the verified profiles to discuss fit and
availability. Confirm Kyler Siegel's USC supervision plans because his own page says Imperial appointment and
USC leave. [s1] [s11] [s12] [s21]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
USC Liaison public help covers Program Materials, recommendation workflow and submission. Once submitted,
existing material is largely locked; permitted additions do not override the Math December 15 deadline.
Transcripts may require up to 15 business days processing in the busy season. [s2] [s6] [s7]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
Fall 2027 central fee and Spring 2027-onward English policy verified. Math's December 15 deadline is
standing/undated. Funding dollar floor is AY 2026-27; Fall 2027 amount unresolved. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s8]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Funding consideration; Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting
documents [Standing rule]
Department states December 15, a hard deadline for all application materials, with no materials accepted
afterward. Public departmental page does not label Fall 2027. Liaison submission/payment cutoff is 11:59 p.m.
Pacific. No separate Math funding or referee grace deadline established; complete by the department deadline.
[s1] [s7]

Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No 2027 Math acceptance deadline verified; follow the individual offer. Do not infer April 15 from old CGS
membership.
English and GRE
English requirement [Conflict]
Math lists TOEFL 100, IELTS 7 or PTE 68. Central policy for Spring 2027 onward accepts TOEFL, IELTS, PTE and
Cambridge C1 Advanced; scores valid two years at submission. Its PhD ISE-exemption thresholds are old TOEFL
100/20 each, new TOEFL 5/4 each, IELTS 7/6 each, PTE 68/53 each, Cambridge 185/169 each; distinguish
placement thresholds from departmental admission rules. Official scores required; ETS 4852. Confirm the Math
policy for the new TOEFL scale/Cambridge. [s1] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Central graduate policy exempts a holder of a US bachelor's degree, including permitted transferred credits.
Completed UChicago degree fits. A still-pending bachelor's is not explicitly covered by 'hold': obtain
confirmation. A bachelor's exemption does not itself exempt the separate ITA interview. ITA test may be
waived for TOEFL speaking/listening 6/5.5 (old 29/25) or IELTS 8.5/7, but the department may still require it.
[s3] [s10]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not considered. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional and considered; especially encouraged for applicants from less familiar institutions or nontraditional
preparation. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Records from every postsecondary institution. USC requires official-issued records; a student-portal printout is
unacceptable. Central transcript instructions allow a scan of an official-issued record, mail or secure electronic
delivery. The application guide also describes official records sent directly; safest is official-issued upload plus
direct delivery. Electronic transcripts go to etrans@usc.edu after submission and receipt of the ten-digit USC
ID. Include original-language records and word-for-word English translations where applicable; no WES
substitute. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate Math course-list requirement identified in the departmental list. Advanced algebra and analysis
prerequisites must be visible in records; inspect the live program questions. [s1]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No mandatory course-description upload established. Prepare descriptions if equivalence of advanced
analysis/algebra is unclear. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required. Ideally all are higher-education mathematics faculty who taught the applicant for at least a
semester within the last three years; at least one should have supervised mathematical research. The page
excludes unsuitable sources such as high-school teachers, TAs, coaches and coworkers; nontraditional paths
should meet the spirit of these criteria. [s1]

Scholarship references [Unresolved]
No additional initial reference stated for the automatically considered Math funding package. External
fellowship requirements are award-specific. [s1] [s9]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Saving a recommendation request sends the invitation immediately; use an accurate email and contact details.
Sender is support@usc.myliaison.com. Referee completes the program's assessment/questions and uploads a
letter. [s6]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations can be sent before submission; not dependent on submitting the paid application. [s6]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Liaison shows completion status/date and sends a recommendation-received notification. Transcript processing
is separate and may take substantially longer. [s6] [s2]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
A completed recommendation cannot be removed or replaced in the application. Unsubmitted requests can be
edited; permitted new requests may be added after submission, subject to Math's hard deadline. Details can
be reused, but reuse of the actual letter across programs/cycles was not established. [s6]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Short CV required. Public Math admissions page gives no exact page count, file format or filename rule. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Statement of purpose required. Exact Math PhD prompt, length and formatting are not published on the
accessible departmental page; inspect Program Materials. Do not import the 750-word Mathematical Finance
master's requirement. [s1] [s6]
Personal / background statement; Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary;
Publications list; Course-list document; Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No distinct requirement or exact prompt established in the public Math PhD checklist; inspect the live
program-specific fields. Absence from the list is not confirmation that an optional slot exists. [s1] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Unresolved]
Research interests may be explained in the statement of purpose; no separate required research-interest
statement or exact prompt established. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
No separate initial essay stated for the standard Math doctoral package. Any outside award has its own
application. [s1] [s9]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
The university's AY 2026-27 minimum total doctoral stipend is $42,436, plus tuition remission and specified
health support. This is a prior-year university floor, not a published Fall 2027 Math offer; the memo does not
justify converting it into a particular monthly or summer schedule. Math promises tuition, health and dental
benefits with its package. [s8] [s1]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All admitted doctoral students receive a five-year support package: typically one fellowship year and four TA
years. [s1]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
The departmental package applies to admitted students regardless of nationality. International teaching
assignments require separate English clearance. [s1] [s10]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Teaching years carry TA duties and university academic/assistantship conditions; detailed annual workload and
renewal milestones were not established from the admissions page. An ITA Pending Test restriction can block
tuition assistance until proficiency or required language-course enrollment is established. [s1] [s10]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Standard departmental support is awarded with admission; no separate support application specified.
University fellowships generally require departmental nomination. [s1] [s9]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
University fellowships and external fellowship coordination are available, subject to award-specific eligibility.
No Math-specific additional guaranteed dollar amount established. [s9]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
$120 for most graduate programs in the Fall 2027 application guide; the older Fall 2026 fee was $105. Pay
electronically using accepted cards. [s2]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Start the application but do not submit/pay before USC approves a waiver; allow three to four business days.
International financial-hardship requests are not generally eligible. Math advertises a specific waiver for NAM
Undergraduate MathFest 2026 attendees: contact Alexis Teodoro (ateodoro@usc.edu) with attendance
confirmation, obtain the department letter, then follow central waiver instructions. Other central qualifying
programs may apply. [s1] [s5]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Departmental English page retains old TOEFL scale and omits Cambridge; central policy is newer. Central
general PhD priority dates are not substituted for Math's December 15 hard cutoff. Transcript pages emphasize
different upload/direct-delivery steps. Department geometry roster does not prominently flag Siegel's leave;
personal page does. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4] [s21]

Confirm expected-degree English exemption, updated Math TOEFL threshold, precise 2027 deadline and time,
exact SOP/CV portal limits, all optional upload slots, final annual stipend/summer coverage, commitment date,
and completed-letter reuse. Request adviser availability, especially Siegel. [s1] [s3] [s6]
